intro: North Korea has about 26 million people, and very little is known about daily life there.

chapters.title: Life under control
text: People are ranked by loyalty to the state, travel needs permission, and the internet is unavailable to almost everyone. Contact with foreign media is punished.
Many people struggle to get enough food. Tens of thousands have escaped, mostly via China, to South Korea.

chapters.title: Human rights
text: A UN inquiry found crimes against humanity, including political prison camps.

keyTerms.meaning: Someone who escapes to another country.
